title: Plan 19: Cedfin or Tŷ Mawr

cast.C_FRED: a draughtsman in the estate office (fictional)

shots.direction: Date-and-place card over an establishing still. Early morning in small-town Cardiff, 1824. A plain Georgian-fronted office on a muddy street, with the old castle curtain wall rising beyond the rooftops. A carter's cart stands outside. Slow push in toward the lit ground-floor window. lines.accent: South Wales (Glamorgan) Welsh; Welsh text marked for native review
lines.cy: Bore da, syr. Gofalwch am yr inc, mae e'n dal yn wlyb. Dyma gynllun pedwar ar bymtheg o arolwg Mr Stewart, wedi'i gopïo'n lân o'i lyfr maes. Y fferm i gyd: cant tri deg naw erw, tri rood ac wyth perch.
lines.en: Good morning, sir. Mind the ink, it's still wet. Here's plan nineteen of Mr Stewart's survey, fair-copied from his field book. The farm in all: one hundred and thirty-nine acres, three roods, eight perches.
lines.es: Buen día, señor. Cuidado con la tinta, que todavía está fresca. Acá está el plano diecinueve del relevamiento del señor Stewart, pasado en limpio de su libreta de campo. La chacra entera: ciento treinta y nueve acres, tres roods y ocho perchas.

shots.direction: Medium close shot of the agent. He bends over the plan, adjusts his spectacles and reads the farm's title aloud, then looks up at the draughtsman.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal 16:9 medium close-up, pale clean-shaven man in his fifties with thin-rimmed spectacles, dark 1820s frock coat and white stock, leaning over a hand-drawn estate plan on a sloped desk, leather document case under his arm, soft window light, 1824 Welsh estate office, no text, no heraldry

lines.accent: educated Glamorgan Welsh; Welsh text marked for native review
lines.cy: 'Cedfin or Ty Mawr Farm.' Dau enw ar yr un fferm, ym mhlwyf Llandochau. Faint o'r tir sy'n goed? A phwy yw'r deiliad?
lines.en: 'Cedfin or Ty Mawr Farm.' Two names for the one farm, in Llandough parish. How much of the land is wood? And who's the occupier?
lines.es: 'Cedfin or Ty Mawr Farm.' Dos nombres para la misma chacra, en la parroquia de Llandough. ¿Cuánto de la tierra es monte? ¿Y quién es el ocupante?

shots.direction: Over-the-shoulder to medium shot of the draughtsman. He runs the blunt end of his quill along the green-washed wood, then to a corner parcel with a different wash and a small inscription.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal 16:9 medium shot, lean sandy-haired man with a moustache in a dark 1820s clerk's coat, pointing with the blunt end of a quill at a corner parcel on a hand-drawn estate plan, green-washed woodland and fields, fine illegible script, brass dividers on the desk, window light, 1824 Welsh estate office, no legible text, no heraldry

lines.accent: South Wales (Glamorgan) Welsh; Welsh text marked for native review
lines.cy: Dau ddeg erw, dau rood a thri deg pump perch o goed. Y deiliad: John Gedrick, hyd y galla i ddarllen llaw Mr Stewart. Ac edrychwch ar y gornel hon, syr: deg erw, tri rood a thri deg naw perch o dir 'y diweddar Thos. Williams', wedi'u hychwanegu at y Tŷ Mawr.
lines.en: Twenty acres, two roods and thirty-five perches of wood. The occupier: John Gedrick, as far as I can read Mr Stewart's hand. And look at this corner, sir: ten acres, three roods and thirty-nine perches of 'late Thos. Williams' land, added to Tŷ Mawr.
lines.es: Veinte acres, dos roods y treinta y cinco perchas de monte. El ocupante: John Gedrick, hasta donde puedo leer la letra del señor Stewart. Y mire esta esquina, señor: diez acres, tres roods y treinta y nueve perchas de tierra 'del finado Thos. Williams', agregadas a Tŷ Mawr.

shots.direction: Medium shot of the agent. He straightens, takes off his spectacles and gives his instruction while closing his document case.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal 16:9 medium shot, pale clean-shaven man in his fifties holding thin-rimmed spectacles in one hand, dark 1820s frock coat, closing a leather document case beside a sloped drawing desk with an estate plan, plain panelled office, soft daylight, Cardiff 1824, no text, no heraldry

lines.accent: educated Glamorgan Welsh; Welsh text marked for native review
lines.cy: Gadewch enw Williams ar y gornel, yn union fel mae Mr Stewart wedi'i roi. Bydd ei angen yn y llyfr rhent. Pan fydd yr inc yn sych, rholiwch e gyda'r lleill.
lines.en: Leave Williams's name on that corner, just as Mr Stewart put it. The rent book will want it. When the ink's dry, roll it up with the rest.
lines.es: Dejá el nombre de Williams en esa esquina, tal cual lo puso el señor Stewart. Lo vamos a necesitar en el libro de rentas. Cuando se seque la tinta, enrollalo con los demás.

shots.direction: Insert close-up of the plan's corner parcel, with its separate wash and tiny illegible inscription. The ink catches the window light as it dries. Slow push in. Ambience only.
